## Overview

This Adapter Validation Suite (AVS) instantiates the [UIAO_121 Adapter Conformance Test Plan](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/adapter-conformance-test-plan-template.md) for the `defender-for-cloud-apps-actions` adapter. It defines the Tier-1 contract-conformance criteria, the controls under validation, and the integration test plan that govern the adapter across its lifecycle.

## Validation status

**Reserved slot — not yet implemented.** `defender-for-cloud-apps-actions` is `status: reserved` / `phase: phase-planning` in canon. No adapter code exists yet. The Tier-1 criteria below define the conformance gate the adapter **must** clear at activation; they are a forward-looking plan, not a current result.

## Scope

Target surfaces / subsystems: `oauth-app-governance`, `session-control-policies`, `conditional-access-app-control`

**Validation artifacts:** `mcas-policy-manifest.json`, `mcas-action-audit.json`

The suite validates that, for each target surface, the adapter normalizes vendor data into canonical claims, emits deterministic provenance, and produces KSI-anchored evidence — without mutating any source system (`ssot-mutation: never`).

## Controls under validation

The control roles below are mirrored from the adapter's companion [Adapter Technical Specification](../../../adapter-specs/defender-for-cloud-apps-actions/defender-for-cloud-apps-actions.html); the validation suite verifies that the adapter produces the evidence each role asserts.

NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls this adapter supports: `AC-3`, `AC-6`, `AC-17`, `AU-2`

| Control | Role | Adapter capability |
|---|---|---|
| **AC-3** Access Enforcement | Primary | Conditional Access App Control bindings + session-control policies are the enforcement edge for SaaS access decisions. |
| **AC-6** Least Privilege | Primary | OAuth app governance revokes or restricts over-permissioned third-party app consents — the change-making half of the least-privilege review that the conformance side observes. |
| **AC-17** Remote Access | Supporting | Session-control policies govern in-session actions for remote / BYOD access to sanctioned SaaS apps. |
| **AU-2** Event Logging | Supporting | Every policy / consent / binding change emits an audit record into the canonical evidence stream. |

## Notes from canon

Reserved slot per ADR-049. Activation requires a per-adapter ADR modeled on ADR-035. The split across both registries (defender-for-cloud-apps in conformance, this entry in modernization) is the precedent set by ADR-049 §Decision 1 for Microsoft surfaces that have both a read-only and a change-making axis.
